ShardFetch is a system information tool for jailbroken iOS, inspired by neofetch and fastfetch.

Run `shardfetch` in your terminal to see your device info alongside a rainbow Apple logo.

**Displays:**
- iOS version & device model
- Jailbreak name & type (rootful/rootless/roothide)
- Uptime, CPU, memory, storage
- Battery status
- Shell & terminal

**Compatibility:**
- iOS 7.0 — 27.0.1 (arm64)
- Rootful, Rootless, and Roothide environments
- Auto-detects jailbreak type

- Initial release
- Rainbow Apple ASCII art
- Device, OS, jailbreak, CPU, memory, storage, battery detection
- Rootful, rootless, and roothide support
